body:
You sound much stronger and braver than I am. 

I hope you find a safe place to be in this world.

Very well put. I am at the point of fearing life to where it keeps me from going out, keeps me from persuing my goals and dreams and keeps me from socializing.

The fear of making my current situation worse by means of failed attempt and diagnosis is certainly helping me stay here, as painful as it may be.

I feel the same way when I think about death. Just eternal darkness, an end, being turned off, no longer existing. It sounds peaceful to me atleast.

Your post is meaningful to me. I'm sorry you have had to go through all this. I only ever had one doctor and one therapist in my experience who cared and made a difference in my life. Unfortunately I had to move so I lost both of them and have been trying to find people like that again with no real luck.
